label: Sons of the Forest sandboxes
description: How Sons of the Forest sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine.

notes: BepInEx itself is not a mod and this app does not install it. Unpack it into the game folder once — the sandbox's plugins go under the BepInEx/plugins folder it creates.

Hard links are the default: a plugin assembly is a real file to the loader, the game folder and the staging folder are almost always the same drive, and nothing has to be copied twice when two sandboxes share a plugin.
BepInEx writes each plugin's settings into BepInEx/config the first time it runs. Those files belong to the game folder rather than to the sandbox, so Settings → Game settings is where to edit them.
